::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 22nd 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 42-43
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I have got into a puzzle how to manage with the further [Scripture readings](cmy_books/cmybook_129.qmd). Clay has printed them so slowly that I have only gone on with them when the arrival of proofs has warned me that copy would be wanted. And  now I find that the volume has come to its regular size - about 250 pp in the middle of the Acts - i e when St Paul is at Ephesus on his 3d journey, and the 1st Epistle to the Corinthians has just been worked in, in parts of course

What shall I do. I should think it  would take about 100pp to finish up in due proportion to the rest, and I suppose we must make the volume take them in. In truth the 3d volume ought to have gone to the end of the Old Testament.

Will [‘Story and History of the Moors and Christians’](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd) in Spain do for the new book -? Is  there any objection to making large extracts from Lockhart’s [Spanish ballads](other_books/otherbook_897.qmd), or would it be safer to /ask\\ consult [Mr Murray](people/person_2312.qmd)’s consent.

I translate for myself when I have the original, but I have not in many cases.

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
